# A const or var group is not a block, so nothing descended into it: every
# comment written inside came out below the whole declaration, in a pile,
# detached from what it documented -- and a leading comment and an inline one
# were concatenated onto a single line, which is two comments becoming one.

# Every comment stays where it was written, so the file is already formatted.
sngl fmt --check groups.sngl

# And formatting it changes nothing.
cp groups.sngl input.sngl
sngl fmt input.sngl
cmp input.sngl groups.sngl

# The pile below the group is what this replaced.
! grep '^// How wide' input.sngl

-- groups.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

// Documents the group itself.
const (
    // How wide the readout is.
    WIDTH = 10

    ROWS = 5 // rows in the keypad
    // A note after the last one, still inside the group.
)

var (
    // A running total.
    total = 0
)

component main {
    text(value="{WIDTH}x{ROWS}{total}")
}
